purpose: Teach: 明後日/ソファー/身の回り/空腹/憶え/定か/あこがれ/わが家

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、明後日は新メニューの発表会よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The day after tomorrow is the new menu reveal, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm opening, gentle curiosity. Soft voice, unhurried. Checking in on something that matters to Aoi. Lingering slightly on the question, inviting her to share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のソファーを取り替えてみない?メイちゃん
lines.en: What if we replaced the sofa in the shop?
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered with genuine openness. Clear, conversational pace. Not commanding — offering an idea to consider together. A small brightness in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の身の回りに気を配ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should pay more attention to the little things our customers need, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not instruction. Soft conviction underneath. 「気を配ろう」lands with quiet care. We, not you — inclusive, collaborative. Trailing slightly upward on the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が空腹で来店されることもあるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some customers come in hungry, you know.
lines.style: Observational, grounded in reality. Matter-of-fact but not unkind. A small realization offered. Steady pace. Quiet weight on 「hungry」 — this matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお名前を憶えるよう努めてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been trying to remember our customers' names.
lines.style: Sincere admission. Soft openness about effort. Not performative — just sharing what she does. Gentle exhale on 「努める」. Small pride in doing this small thing well.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、開店時間、いつまで定かにできない時もあるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Sometimes I'm still not sure when we should open, to be honest.
lines.style: Self-aware vulnerability wrapped in wry humor. Light, not heavy. Acknowledges the gap between intention and reality. Dry smile in the voice. A confession between friends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、私、海外カフェにあこがれてるの、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've always been drawn to the way overseas cafés do things.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Eyes brightening on the image. Not naive — genuine admiration. Pace quickens slightly on 「海外カフェ」. A dream she's held quietly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、わが家のお気に入りメニュー、新作にも追加しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's add some of our favorite dishes to the new menu too, all right?
lines.style: Warm suggestion closing the moment. Gentle conviction. 「わが家」softens into shared belonging. Trailing close with affection — settling into something together.
